technical-summary: PWR09 slice 2: gpu-power apply/restore go through PowerTransaction (layout-scoped, lease-verified, journalled, all or nothing); positive lease ownership check; launcher exits 97 before starting anything when an explicit --gpu-power fails and restores only after every process has exited.
user-summary-candidate: Requested GPU power settings are now applied safely and all-or-nothing; a failed request stops the launch instead of serving at defaults.
